name: zgeometry_convex_polygon_set_destroy
description: zGeometry_ConvexPolygonSet::Destroy frees optional polygon and point arrays and then frees the set header, with a null no-op path.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry convexification source-cluster pass.
